name: io.github.drolosoft/go-docs-mcp
title: go-docs-mcp
description: Lets your AI read PDF, Office files, EPUB, HTML, Jupyter and images, with OCR, search and paging.

requirements.poppler: required: pdftotext, pdfinfo and pdfimages for PDF text, metadata and images
requirements.tesseract: optional: OCR of scanned PDFs and images
requirements.pandoc: optional: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, EPUB, HTML, RTF and IPYNB

environmentVariables.name: DOCS_MCP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder with the documents to serve. When unset the server uses ~/.docs-mcp/documents/.

environmentVariables.name: DOCS_MCP_DISABLE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to remove the read_url tool.

environmentVariables.name: DOCS_MCP_OCR_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Tesseract language for OCR, for example spa or eng+spa. Default eng.

environmentVariables.name: DOCS_MCP_CACHE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Cap of the extracted text cache in MB. Default 256, 0 disables it.

environmentVariables.name: DOCS_MCP_URL_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 so read_url honours HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY.
